dog.description_text:
Hi there! I'm Chocolate Chip, a petite 2-month-old boy with a striking black and tan coat and a heart full of adventure 🐾 Already neutered and ready to roll, I'm packed with energy and smarts — I love to play and explore, though I do have a mischievous streak that keeps life interesting! I'm friendly as they come and eager to bond with my forever family 😊 Come meet me and let's start our next chapter together!
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location. We invite you to visit, no appointment needed!
Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Chocolate Chip
